_comment: Pipeline guard hook — blocks direct v_psa_stg file creation without orchestrator approval.
_comment_compat: Dual-protocol: VS Code Copilot (version 1 / preToolUse / bash / exit codes) + Claude Code (PreToolUse / command / JSON stdout).
_comment_python: Uses system python3 (not .venv/bin/python3) because pre_tool_guard.py only uses stdlib (json, os, re, sys, pathlib).
_comment_mode: Set FBIN_HOOK_MODE=enforce to block. Default is 'audit' (log only, never blocks).
